    1. NitriteConnectionOperations(Nitrite)

Class NitriteConnectionOperations

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.connection.support.AbstractConnectionOperations<org.dizitart.no2.transaction.Session>
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.transaction.NitriteConnectionOperations
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.data.connection.ConnectionOperations<org.dizitart.no2.transaction.Session>, io.micronaut.data.connection.SynchronousConnectionManager<org.dizitart.no2.transaction.Session>
public class NitriteConnectionOperations extends io.micronaut.data.connection.support.AbstractConnectionOperations<org.dizitart.no2.transaction.Session> implements io.micronaut.data.connection.SynchronousConnectionManager<org.dizitart.no2.transaction.Session>
Connection operations for Nitrite.

Extends AbstractConnectionOperations to track connections via Micronaut's propagation mechanisms (PropagatedContext), enabling correct session management and transaction propagation.

Important Design Note: This class is stateless. It does NOT use a ThreadLocal for connection tracking; instead, it relies on the base class implementation which uses PropagatedContext. This ensures consistent session state across propagated or nested transactions.

Since:
5.2.0
